segments.MAT.27.6-8: The chief priests buy the potter’s field with the silver
segments.MAT.27.9-10: Jeremiah’s words about the thirty silver pieces come true
segments.MAT.27.15-16: Pilate had a custom to free one prisoner at the feast
segments.MAT.27.17-19: Pilate asks the crowd to choose Barabbas or Jesus
segments.MAT.27.20-22: The crowd asks for Barabbas and for Jesus to be crucified
segments.MAT.27.23-23: The crowd shouts louder for Jesus to be crucified
segments.MAT.27.24-24: Pilate washes his hands and says he is innocent
segments.MAT.27.25-26: Pilate frees Barabbas and hands Jesus over to be crucified
segments.MAT.27.27-29: The soldiers dress Jesus as a king and mock him
segments.MAT.27.30-31: The soldiers spit on Jesus, strike him, and lead him away
segments.MAT.27.35-37: Soldiers divide Jesus’ clothes and put up the charge
segments.MAT.27.38-40: Two robbers are crucified, and people mock Jesus
segments.MAT.27.41-42: The religious leaders mock Jesus on the cross
segments.MAT.27.43-44: Leaders and robbers insult Jesus on the cross
segments.MAT.27.45-47: Darkness comes, and Jesus cries out to God
segments.MAT.27.48-50: Someone gives Jesus sour wine, and Jesus dies
segments.MAT.27.54-56: The centurion says Jesus is the Son of God
segments.MAT.27.57-58: Joseph of Arimathea asks Pilate for Jesus’ body
segments.MAT.27.59-61: Joseph puts Jesus in his own new tomb
segments.MAT.27.62-64: The chief priests ask Pilate to secure the tomb
segments.MAT.27.65-66: Pilate allows a guard, and the tomb is sealed
segments.MAT.28.1-2: Two women come to the tomb, and an angel opens it
segments.MAT.28.3-4: The guards shake with fear of the angel
segments.MAT.28.5-7: The angel tells the women that Jesus has risen
segments.MAT.28.8-10: Jesus meets the women, who worship him
segments.MAT.28.11-13: The chief priests pay the guards to tell a lie
segments.MAT.28.14-15: The guards take the money and spread the false story
segments.MAT.28.16-17: The eleven disciples see Jesus in Galilee and worship
segments.MAT.28.18-19: Jesus tells the disciples to make disciples of all nations
segments.MAT.28.20-20: Jesus promises to be with the disciples always
